Here are a few popular 3D printable [3DBenchy](wiki:3DBenchy) models ranging from the classic benchmark to fun remixes:

* [3D BENCHY](embed:3d-benchy-h56) — The iconic standard [3DBenchy](wiki:3DBenchy) designed specifically as a calibration test for [3D printing](wiki:3D_printing) overhangs, bridging, and dimensional accuracy.
* [All Terrain Assault Benchy](embed:all-terrain-assault-K6L) — A fully articulated, mech-style robot walker variant of the classic boat.
* [Blocky Benchy](embed:blocky-benchy-gLJ) — A voxelized, pixel-art style take on the model.
* [Benchy (Kraken Attack Edition)](embed:benchy-kraken-attack-GQI) — A fun remix featuring tentacles dragging the boat down.
* [Booenchy : The Spookiest Little Halloween Ghost Benchy Boat](embed:booenchy-the-spookiest-WKG) — A ghost costume version draped in cloth.

What kind of test print or modification are you looking for? I can help you with slicing tips, printer calibration settings, or ideas for custom remixes.
